description: You are a Second Officer on MV Northern Crown preparing for an early morning transit of the English Channel from the Dover Strait southwestward toward the Channel Islands. Using Bridge Command, create a complete passage planning exercise scenario and all supporting documents. Requirements: (1) Create a new scenario directory '/opt/bridgecommand/Scenarios/o) Dover Channel Transit' with all three INI files. (2) In environment.ini: set Setting='English Channel East', StartTime=5.5 (pre-dawn), Weather=4.0 (moderate sea state), VisibilityRange=8.0, StartMonth=11 (November), StartYear=2024. (3) In ownship.ini: vessel 'MV Northern Crown' at Dover Strait coordinates (Lat ~51.05-51.15, Long ~1.20-1.40), heading ~220 (southwest), speed 12 knots, with GPS and depth sounder enabled. (4) In othership.ini: create exactly 5 traffic vessels representing typical Channel traffic — at least one container ship, one tanker, one ferry (cross-channel), one fishing vessel, and one sailing yacht. Each vessel needs 2-3 waypoint legs with realistic speeds. (5) Configure bc5.ini: set full_radar=1, max_radar_range=72, radar_angular_resolution=720, and hide_instruments=0. (6) Create a passage plan document at /home/ga/Documents/passage_plan.txt containing: vessel name, departure/destination, planned route with at least 4 waypoints (lat/long), estimated speed, expected hazards (TSS, traffic, weather), and communication plan (VHF channels). Login: ga / password123.
